visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Split-screen layout. The top left corner shows a mini-map of a game. The top right corner features a woman in a grey t-shirt sitting in an indoor environment, intensely playing a game on her smartphone with focused eyes. The bottom half of the frame displays a direct recording of a mobile game interface (Arena of Valor) with characters engaging in combat. (2) A sharp cut occurs to a cinematic close-up of a long-haired man in a drama setting looking sideways, followed by a black screen with white text explaining game mechanics. (3) The split-screen resumes, now with yellow and blue circular overlays highlighting specific icons on the game interface. Red arrows and numeric timers appear on screen to emphasize gameplay steps. (4) The woman on the top right reappears after a series of fast game cuts, making broad, sweeping arm gestures and smiling excitedly while looking directly into her camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice shouts excitedly about a legendary 'Time Freeze' skill over rhythmic electronic music and loud game combat sounds. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound transition leads to a brief male vocal clip from a film, sounding calm and ironic. (3) New high-tempo synthesizer BGM starts. A male narrator begins a fast-paced, enthusiastic tutorial with clear articulation, punctuated by frequent digital 'ding' and 'pop' SFX for visual emphasis. (4) Heavy impact sounds and cartoonish 'swish' effects accompany the climax of the gameplay footage. The narration increases in volume and speed. (5) Final phase includes a loud comic shout and a high-pitched synthesizer swell as the video ends with energetic vocal delivery.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Reference -> Step-by-step Tutorial -> Gameplay Demonstration -> Enthusiastic Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide an entertaining and informative tutorial for Arena of Valor players on how to execute a specific high-power hero combination (Haino and Dolia), utilizing humor and fast editing to maximize engagement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: This is a typical social-media gaming short that combines professional tutorial logic with high-energy meme editing to capture the viewer's attention quickly.
